newsitem.title: USA: Alltrista Q3 EPS may not meet expectations.
newsitem.headline: Alltrista Q3 EPS may not meet expectations.

text.p: Alltrista Corp said on Wednesday its third-quarter earnings probably would not meet analysts' expectations, which range between $0.71 and $0.74 per share.
Last year's third quarter earnings per share were $0.60, before a special charge of $0.18.

"The shortfall will come primarily from two areas: LumenX, the company's inspection equipment business that is expected to operate at a loss for the quarter, and the consumer products business," said president Thomas Clark.
"This year's poor growing conditions in many regions have reduced demand for home canning supplies. Our consumer research indicates, however, that interest in home canning remains high," he added.
Clark said costs associated with the March 15 acquisition of the Kerr home canning product line also weighed on results.
A spokesman said the company's 1996 third-quarter results likely will fall below $0.60 per share.

"We incurred some duplicate costs in the 1996 season. These will be eliminated as the businesses are integrated. Manufacturing plant consolidation will be implemented this fall," Clark noted in the statement. He said the combination is going smoothly and he expects the 1997 economies projected at the time of the acquisition to be fully realized.
Alltrista manufactures consumer, plastic and zinc products.
